subject: AP onboarding: PO prerequisites & vendor portal credential exchange (Zephyr Dynamics)
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@zephyrdynamics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor registration + AP requirements (Redwood Inference)

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks for the call this morning. Zephyr is ready to onboard Redwood as a vendor in our AP system. Attached is our standard vendor intake form — please complete and return.

Key items we need to complete registration and accept POs/payments:
- Completed vendor intake form (attached)
- W-9 or equivalent tax certificate for the billing entity
- Bank details for ACH (routing + account) or instructions for wire payments
- Remit-to address and invoice email (we prefer a machine-readable PDF or CSV for high-volume vendors)
- Confirmation of VAT treatment (if applicable) and VAT registration number

Our AP team will require the vendor record to include the following PO fields:
- Zephyr PO number (mandatory on invoice)
- Bill-to code (we will provide after registration)
- Payment terms (Net 30 is standard)

Please send the completed form and your W-9. I can also send a portal invite for direct vendor setup if that's easier.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Zephyr Dynamics

Attachment: zephyr_vendor_form.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@zephyrdynamics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + AP requirements (Redwood Inference)

Hi Asha — thanks, we got it.

Quick answers and next steps from our side:
- Attached: signed W-9 (redwood_w9_signed.pdf) and a short vendor profile spreadsheet (redwood_vendor_profile.xlsx) with our remit address and PO contact.
- Bank details: we prefer ACH; included in the vendor profile. If you need an additional routing confirmation letter, let us know.
- Invoice format: we can produce single-PDF invoices and a CSV export with line-level detail. Please confirm preferred file type for automated ingestion.
- VAT: Redwood is US-based; no VAT ID. We will include US tax info on the vendor profile.

PO requirements noted — we'll ensure the Zephyr PO number is present on all invoices. If you can provide the bill-to code (or a sample PO), we will run a test invoice once registration is complete.

If you prefer the portal flow, happy to use that — you can send the registration link and we will complete the account creation.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts (Sales)
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Vendor portal invite + next steps (Zephyr Dynamics)

Jonas / Laura —

Portal invite sent. Use the link below to create your vendor account and upload the signed W-9 and bank details. Once submitted, our team will validate and issue the Zephyr Vendor ID. Expected turnaround: 2-3 business days after submission.

Registration link: https://zephyrdynamics.app/vendor/register?token=ABCD1234
DocuSign (optional for bank authorization): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ef12-34gh

Notes on required fields in the portal:
- Legal entity name (match W-9)
- ACH/wire banking information (include bank letter if requested)
- Remit-to address and invoice email (we will set invoice routing based on this)
- Tax document upload (W-9 for US entities)

Attachments included: portal-invite.html

If you run into issues with the portal, reply here and I'll connect you to our AP analyst.

Thanks — AP Team
Zephyr Dynamics

Next internal step: Sean, please add ZPH-V-8492 to our AR system and tag the account with deal id ZPH-2026-042. I'll follow up if Zephyr requests any additional evidence.

Thanks — good momentum.

Laura Bennett
